name: cfinput
description:
Used inside cfform to place radio buttons, checkboxes, or text boxes. Provides input
validation for the specified control type.

params.name: autosuggest
params.description:
Specifies entry completion suggestions to
display as the user types into a text input. The
user can select a suggestion to complete the text
entry.

The valid value can be either of the following:

- A string consisting of the suggestion values
separated by the delimiter specified by the
delimiter attribute.
- A bind expression that gets the suggestion
values based on the current input text.
Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: autosuggestBindDelay
params.description:
The minimum time between autosuggest bind
expression invocations, in seconds. Use this
attribute to limit the number of requests that are
sent to the server when a user types.
Valid only for cfinput type="text"

params.name: autosuggestMinLength
params.description:
The minimum number of characters required in
the text box before invoking a bind expression to
return items for suggestion.

Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: delimiter
params.description: The delimiter to use to separate entries in a static autosuggest list. This attribute is meaningful only if the autosuggest attribute is a string of delimited values.

params.name: maxResultsDisplayed
params.description:
The maximum number suggestions to display in the autosuggest list.
Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: onBindError
params.description: The name of a JavaScript function to execute if evaluating a bind expression, including an autosuggest bind expression, results in an error. The function must take two attributes: an HTTP status code and a message.

params.name: showAutosuggestLoadingIcon
params.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether to display an animated icon when loading an autosuggest value for a text input.

params.name: sourceForTooltip
params.description:
The URL of a page to display as a tool tip. The page can include HTML markup to control the format, and the tip can include images.
If you specify this attribute, an animated icon appears with the text "Loading..." while the tip is being loaded.

params.name: typeahead
params.description:
A Boolean value that specifies whether the autosuggest feature should automatically complete a user's entry with the first result in the suggestion list.

Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: validateAt
params.description:
How to do the validation; one or more of the following:
onSubmit, onServer or onBlur.
onBlur and onSubmit are identical in Flash forms. For
multiple values, use a comma-delimited list.
Default: onSubmit

params.name: type
params.description:
The input control type to create:

- button: push button.
- checkbox: check box.
- file: file selector; not supported in Flash.
- hidden: invisible control.
- image: clickable button with an image.
- password: password entry control; hides input values.
- radio: radio button.
- reset: form reset button.
- submit: form submission button.
- text: text entry box.
- datefield: Flash only; date entry field with an expanding calendar for selecting dates.

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the form input element.

params.name: value
params.description: An initial value for the form input element.

params.name: required
params.description: Enter Yes or No. Default is No.

params.name: range
params.description: Enter a minimum and maximum value range, separated by a comma. Valid only for numeric data.

params.name: validate
params.description:
- date: verifies format mm/dd/yy.
- eurodate: verifies date format dd/mm/yyyy.
- time: verifies time format hh:mm:ss.
- float: verifies floating point format.
- integer: verifies integer format.
- telephone: verifies telephone format ###-###-####. The separator can be a blank. Area code and exchange must begin with digit 1 - 9.
- zipcode: verifies, in U.S. formats only, 5- or 9-digit format #####-####. The separator can be a blank.
- creditcard: strips blanks and dashes; verifies number using mod10 algorithm. Number must have 13-16 digits.
- social_security_number: verifies format ###-##-####. The separator can be a blank.
- regular_expression: matches input against pattern attribute.

params.name: bind
params.description:
**(not supported)**
A Flash bind expression that populates the field with information from other form fields.

params.name: bindAttribute
params.description:
Specifies the HTML tag attribute whose value is
set by the bind attribute. You can only specify
attributes in the browser's HTML DOM tree, not
Lucee-specific attributes.
Ignored if there is no bind attribute.
Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: bindOnLoad
params.description:
A Boolean value that specifies whether to
execute the bind attribute expression when first
loading the form.
Ignored if there is no bind attribute.
Valid only for cfinput type="text".

params.name: checked
params.description:
Selects a control. No value is required. Applies if
type=radio or checkbox.
Default: false

params.name: daynames
params.description:
A comma-delimited list that sets the names of the
weekdays displayed in the calendar. Sunday is the
first day and the rest of the weekday names follow in
the normal order.

Default is: S,M,T,W,Th,F,S

params.name: firstDayOfWeek
params.description:
Integer in the range 0-6 specifying the first day of the
week in the calendar, 0 indicates Sunday, 6 indicates Saturday.
Default is: 0

params.name: monthNames
params.description:
A comma-delimited list of the month names that are
displayed at the top of the calendar.

params.name: height
params.description:
Applies to most Flash types, HTML image type on
some browsers. The height of the control, in pixels. The
displayed height might be less than the specified size.

params.name: width
params.description:
Applies to most Flash types, HTML image type on
some browsers. The width of the control, in pixels. For
Flash forms, Lucee ignores this attribute if you also
specify a size attribute value.

params.name: hspace
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: label
params.description:
Label to put next to the control on a Flash or XML form.
Not used for button, hidden, image, reset, or submit types.

params.name: mask
params.description:
A mask pattern that controls the character pattern that
users can enter, or that the form sends to Lucee.

In HTML and Flash for type=text use:

- A = [A-Za-z]
- X = [A-Za-z0-9]
- 9 = [0-9]
- ? = Any character
- all other = the literal character

In Flash for type=datefield use:

- D = day; can use 0-2 mask characters.
- M = month; can use 0-4 mask characters.
- Y = year; can use 0, 2, or 4 characters.
- E = day in week; can use 0-4 characters.

params.name: disabled
params.description:
Disables user input, making the control read-only. To
disable input, specify disabled without an attribute or
disabled="true". To enable input, omit the attribute
or specify disabled="false".

params.name: onValidate
params.description:
The name of a JavaScript function used to validate user input. The form object, input object,
	and input object value are passed to the specified routine, which should return true if validation
	succeeds and false otherwise. If used, the validate attribute is ignored.

params.name: pattern
params.description:
The JavaScript regular expression pattern to use to validate the input. Required only if you
	specify validate = "regular_expression".

params.name: message
params.description: Message text to appear if validation fails.

params.name: onError
params.description: The name of a JavaScript function you want to execute in the event of a failed validation.

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the input control. Ignored if type is Radio or Checkbox.

params.name: maxLength
params.description: The maximum length of text entered, if n type is Text.

params.name: passThrough

If you specify an attribute and value,
they are passed to the HTML code generated for the cfinput tag.

params.name: enabled
params.description:
Flash only: Boolean value specifying whether the control is
enabled. A disabled control appears in light gray. The
inverse of the disabled attribute. Flash only.
Default: true

params.name: visible
params.description:
Flash only: Boolean value specifying whether to show the
control. Space that would be occupied by an invisible
control is blank.
Default: true

params.name: tooltip
params.description:
Flash only: Text to display when the mouse pointer hovers
over the control.

params.name: autocomplete
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies the types of files that can be submitted through a file upload (only for type="file")

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Specifies that the input field should have focus on page load (not for type="hidden")

params.name: form
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies one or more forms the input field belongs to

params.name: formaction
params.description: HTML attribute: Overrides the form's action attribute. Must be a valid URL that defines where to send the data when the form is submitted (for type="submit" and type="image")

params.name: formenctype
params.description: HTML attribute: Overrides the form's enctype attribute. Specifies how form-data should be encoded before sending it to the server (for type="submit" and type="image")

params.name: formmethod
params.description: HTML attribute: Overrides the form's method attribute. Defines the HTTP method for sending data to the action URL (for type="submit" and type="image")

params.name: formnovalidate
params.description: HTML attribute: Overrides the form's novalidate attribute. If present the input field should not be validated when submitted

params.name: formtarget
params.description: HTML attribute: Overrides the form's target attribute. Specifies the target window used when the form is submitted (for type="submit" and type="image")

params.name: list
params.description: HTML attribute: Refers to a datalist containing predefined options for the input field

params.name: max
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies the input field's maximum value. Use together with the "min" attribute to create a range of legal values

params.name: min
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies the input field's minimum value. Use together with the "max" attribute to create a range of legal values

params.name: multiple
params.description: HTML attribute: If present the user is allowed more than one value

params.name: placeholder
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies a hint to help users fill out the input field

params.name: step
params.description: HTML attribute: Specifies the legal number intervals for the input field
